nusmp.page.book_mirror.reflect_iris: Reflect Iris - a ring of mirrors shows every foe within 14 blocks that is looking at you its own gaze: they are paralysed for 3 s (shorter on bosses, after the shared control gate), their magic is jammed and they take 6 x EP scale. Foes looking away are left alone.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.glass_garb: Glass Garb - for 20 s the Glass Garb wraps you: a crown of mirror panes, an oval mirror breastplate, a fan of floating mirrors behind your back. A third of every shot or spell that strikes you is thrown back at whoever sent it; the rest is cut by 15 percent.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.full_reflection: Full Reflection - for 8 s a great mirror stands before you and follows you, turning back every shot and returning 60% of every blow to whoever struck.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.mirrors_slash: Mirrors Slash - blade-edged mirrors spin out in a wide arc in front of you, flying along their rays. The cut glass leaves your foes fragile.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.mirrors_meteorite: Mirrors Meteorite - a storm of blade-edged mirrors falls where you aim and bursts into blinding glare and razor glass.
